```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import re
import csv
import html
import os
from glob import glob
from IPython.display import HTML, display

script_dir = Path(".").resolve()
pattern = re.compile(r"^project_(\d+)_employee_sparklines_rev(\d+)\.png$", re.IGNORECASE)

# Project 66389248 aggregates multiple tasks; its breakdown charts are rendered
# directly below its own project page.
TASK_BREAKDOWN_PROJECT_ID = 66389248
task_pattern = re.compile(r"^task_(\d+)_employee_sparklines_rev(\d+)\.png$", re.IGNORECASE)

requested_project_ids = [
    88341467,
    84929307,
    83437623,
    93076382,
    92781007,
    94279174,
    92781028,
    92723243,
    66389248,
    93159133,
    92777746,
    94279211,
    92723205,
    82757598,
    83466138,
    52104089,
    92781049,
    93176164,
    94469212,
    94696184,
]

# The Python producer applies the final Support-hours ordering used by the PDF.
report_project_ids = requested_project_ids.copy()

project_reference_rows = [
    {"Category": "ADMIN", "Project": "ABSENT, FLEXTIME, HOLIDAY", "Code": "ABS", "Project Id": 88341467},
    {"Category": "ADMIN", "Project": "TRAINING", "Code": "TRN", "Project Id": 84929307},
    {"Category": "ADMIN", "Project": "ENGINEERING MANAGEMENT", "Code": "ENGM", "Project Id": 83437623},
    {"Category": "NPD", "Project": "CPS G5 AUSTRALIA", "Code": "R&DO", "Project Id": 93076382},
    {"Category": "NPD", "Project": "CPS GEN5 IEEE 2800", "Code": "R&DG", "Project Id": 92781007},
    {"Category": "NPD", "Project": "CPS G5.1", "Code": "R&DA", "Project Id": 94279174},
    {"Category": "NPD", "Project": "DPS PV", "Code": "R&DZ", "Project Id": 92781028},
    {"Category": "NPD", "Project": "150KW ISOLATED DC/DC - DAB", "Code": "R&DN", "Project Id": 92723243},
    {"Category": "SUPPORT", "Project": "PRODUCT LINE", "Code": "--", "Project Id": 66389248},
    {"Category": "SUPPORT", "Project": "ERCOT MODELING", "Code": "CPS5", "Project Id": 93159133},
    {"Category": "SUPPORT", "Project": "CPS GEN5 2ND SOURCING", "Code": "R&D4", "Project Id": 92777746},
    {"Category": "SUPPORT", "Project": "AI EMULATOR", "Code": "R&DF", "Project Id": 94279211},
    {"Category": "SUPPORT", "Project": "EMT MODELING", "Code": "R&DB", "Project Id": 92723205},
    {"Category": "SUPPORT", "Project": "CPS GEN5 SALT FOG FILTER", "Code": "R&DE", "Project Id": 82757598},
    {"Category": "SUPPORT", "Project": "DSP CONTROLLER", "Code": "R&DM", "Project Id": 83466138},
    {"Category": "SUPPORT", "Project": "DPS-1000 OPTIONS", "Code": "R&DV", "Project Id": 52104089},
    {"Category": "SUPPORT", "Project": "DPS1000 2ND SOURCING", "Code": "R&DJ", "Project Id": 92781049},
    {"Category": "SUPPORT", "Project": "MEDIUM LEVEL CONTROLLER", "Code": "--", "Project Id": 93176164},
    {"Category": "FIELD SVC", "Project": "ENGINEERING SUPPORT", "Code": "--", "Project Id": 94469212},
    {"Category": "FIELD SVC", "Project": "532034*001 | VOLTIFY INC | INV-CPS-S--FLDSRVC | 149452", "Code": "--", "Project Id": 94696184},
]
project_reference_by_id = {row["Project Id"]: row for row in project_reference_rows}

env_report_root = os.getenv("LP_REPORT_ROOT", "").strip()
search_dirs = []
if env_report_root:
    search_dirs.append(Path(env_report_root).resolve())
search_dirs.extend([script_dir, script_dir.parent])
asset_dir = None
matches = []
for candidate_dir in search_dirs:
    candidate_matches = []
    for image_file in candidate_dir.glob("project_*_employee_sparklines_rev*.png"):
        match = pattern.match(image_file.name)
        if match:
            project_id = int(match.group(1))
            revision = int(match.group(2))
            candidate_matches.append((revision, project_id, image_file))
    if candidate_matches:
        asset_dir = candidate_dir
        matches = candidate_matches
        break

if not matches:
    display(HTML(
        "No project sparkline PNG files were found in this folder. "
        "Run Sparkline_LP_Project-plotting.py first."
    ))
else:
    latest_revision = max(revision for revision, _, _ in matches)
    latest_revision_images = [
        (project_id, image_file)
        for revision, project_id, image_file in matches
        if revision == latest_revision
    ]
    project_image_by_id = {project_id: image_file for project_id, image_file in latest_revision_images}

    # Resolve project names from the latest curated CSV so labels match plot titles.
    project_name_by_id = {}
    project_total_hours_by_id = {}
    available_project_ids = set()
    latest_csv = (asset_dir or script_dir) / f"hours_by_month_project_data_rev{latest_revision}.csv"
    if latest_csv.exists():
        with latest_csv.open("r", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as csv_file:
            reader = csv.DictReader(csv_file)
            for row in reader:
                try:
                    project_id = int(float(row.get("Project Id", "")))
                except (TypeError, ValueError):
                    continue
                available_project_ids.add(project_id)
                project_name = str(row.get("Project", "")).strip()
                if project_name and project_id not in project_name_by_id:
                    project_name_by_id[project_id] = project_name
                try:
                    hours_value = float(row.get("Hours (h)", "0"))
                except (TypeError, ValueError):
                    hours_value = 0.0
                project_total_hours_by_id[project_id] = project_total_hours_by_id.get(project_id, 0.0) + hours_value

    # Backfill names for missing IDs using older project data revisions when available.
    csv_glob = str((asset_dir or script_dir) / "hours_by_month_project_data_rev*.csv")
    historical_csvs = sorted(glob(csv_glob), reverse=True)
    for historical_csv_path in historical_csvs:
        with open(historical_csv_path, "r", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as csv_file:
            reader = csv.DictReader(csv_file)
            for row in reader:
                try:
                    project_id = int(float(row.get("Project Id", "")))
                except (TypeError, ValueError):
                    continue
                if project_id in project_name_by_id:
                    continue
                project_name = str(row.get("Project", "")).strip()
                if project_name:
                    project_name_by_id[project_id] = project_name

    missing_project_ids = sorted(set(requested_project_ids) - available_project_ids)

    # Keep Support projects together and order them by descending total hours.
    report_project_ids = []
    for category in ['ADMIN', 'NPD', 'SUPPORT', 'FIELD SVC']:
        category_project_ids = [
            project_id for project_id in requested_project_ids
            if project_reference_by_id.get(project_id, {}).get('Category') == category
        ]
        category_project_ids.sort(
            key=lambda project_id: project_total_hours_by_id.get(project_id, 0.0),
            reverse=True,
        )
        report_project_ids.extend(category_project_ids)

    # Discover the Task Id breakdown images/names for the rollup project.
    task_image_by_id = {}
    for image_file in (asset_dir or script_dir).glob("task_*_employee_sparklines_rev*.png"):
        task_match = task_pattern.match(image_file.name)
        if task_match and int(task_match.group(2)) == latest_revision:
            task_image_by_id[int(task_match.group(1))] = image_file

    task_name_by_id = {}
    task_total_hours_by_id = {}
    task_csv = (asset_dir or script_dir) / f"task_hours_by_month_data_rev{latest_revision}.csv"
    if task_csv.exists():
        with task_csv.open("r", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as csv_file:
            reader = csv.DictReader(csv_file)
            for row in reader:
                try:
                    task_id = int(float(row.get("Task Id", "")))
                except (TypeError, ValueError):
                    continue
                task_name = str(row.get("Task", "")).strip()
                if task_name and task_id not in task_name_by_id:
                    task_name_by_id[task_id] = task_name
                try:
                    hours_value = float(row.get("Hours (h)", "0"))
                except (TypeError, ValueError):
                    hours_value = 0.0
                task_total_hours_by_id[task_id] = task_total_hours_by_id.get(task_id, 0.0) + hours_value

    # Highest total hours (across all employees/months) first, lowest last.
    ordered_task_ids = sorted(
        task_image_by_id.keys(),
        key=lambda task_id: task_total_hours_by_id.get(task_id, 0.0),
        reverse=True,
    )

    # Keep report order aligned to the requested ID sequence (Project 66389248 last) and skip IDs with no data/image.
    latest_project_images = [
        (project_id, project_image_by_id[project_id])
        for project_id in report_project_ids
        if project_id in project_image_by_id and (not project_name_by_id or project_id in project_name_by_id)
    ]

    def project_label(project_id: int) -> str:
        project_name = project_name_by_id.get(project_id) or project_reference_by_id.get(project_id, {}).get("Project", "Unknown Project")
        project_total = project_total_hours_by_id.get(project_id, 0.0)
        return f"{project_name} | Project ID {project_id} | Total: {project_total:.1f}h"

    toc_items = [
        f"<li><a href='#project-{project_id}'>{html.escape(project_label(project_id))}</a></li>"
        for project_id, _ in latest_project_images
    ]

    html_parts = [
        f"<p>Using project sparkline images from revision {latest_revision}.</p>",
    ]

    category_chart_specs = [
        (f"category_hours_by_month_rev{latest_revision}.png", "Monthly Hours by Category"),
        (f"category_percent_by_month_rev{latest_revision}.png", "Monthly Category Share (100% Stacked)"),
    ]
    for chart_file_name, chart_title in category_chart_specs:
        chart_file = (asset_dir or script_dir) / chart_file_name
        if chart_file.exists():
            chart_src = os.path.relpath(str(chart_file), start=str(script_dir)).replace('\\', '/')
            html_parts.extend([
                "<section class='report-page'>",
                f"<h2>{html.escape(chart_title)}</h2>",
                f"<img src='{chart_src}' alt='{html.escape(chart_title)}'>",
                "</section>",
            ])

    reference_rows_html = "".join(
        (
            "<tr>"
            f"<td>{html.escape(str(row['Category']))}</td>"
            f"<td>{html.escape(str(row['Project']))}</td>"
            f"<td>{html.escape(str(row['Code']))}</td>"
            f"<td>{row['Project Id']}</td>"
            "</tr>"
        )
        for row in project_reference_rows
    )
    html_parts.extend([
        "<section class='toc report-page'>",
        "<h2>Clean Energy Systems and R&amp;D | Project Time Allocation</h2>",
        "<table>",
        "<thead><tr><th>Category</th><th>Project</th><th>Code</th><th>Project ID</th></tr></thead>",
        f"<tbody>{reference_rows_html}</tbody>",
        "</table>",
        "</section>",
    ])

    if missing_project_ids:
        missing_list_items = "".join(
            f"<li>{html.escape(project_name_by_id.get(project_id) or project_reference_by_id.get(project_id, {}).get('Project', 'Unknown Project'))} | Project ID {project_id}</li>"
            for project_id in missing_project_ids
        )
        html_parts.extend([
            "<section class='toc report-page'>",
            "<h2>Missing Project IDs (No Data in Latest Revision)</h2>",
            f"<ul>{missing_list_items}</ul>",
            "</section>",
        ])

    html_parts.extend([
        "<nav class='toc report-page' id='project-toc'>",
        "<h2>Project Table of Contents</h2>",
        "<ul>",
        *toc_items,
        "</ul>",
        "</nav>",
    ])

    for project_id, image_file in latest_project_images:
        label = html.escape(project_label(project_id))
        image_src = os.path.relpath(str(image_file), start=str(script_dir)).replace('\\', '/')
        html_parts.append(
            """
<section class='project-page' id='project-{project_id}'>
  <h2>{label}</h2>
  <img src='{image_src}' alt='Project ID {project_id} sparkline'>
    <p class='back-to-toc'><a href='#project-toc'>Back to TOC</a></p>
</section>
""".strip().format(project_id=project_id, image_src=image_src, label=label)
        )

        if project_id == TASK_BREAKDOWN_PROJECT_ID:
            for task_id in ordered_task_ids:
                task_image_file = task_image_by_id[task_id]
                task_total = task_total_hours_by_id.get(task_id, 0.0)
                task_label = html.escape(
                    f"{task_name_by_id.get(task_id, 'Unknown Task')} | Task ID {task_id} | Total: {task_total:.1f}h"
                )
                task_image_src = os.path.relpath(str(task_image_file), start=str(script_dir)).replace('\\', '/')
                html_parts.append(
                    """
<section class='project-page' id='task-{task_id}'>
  <h2>{task_label}</h2>
  <img src='{task_image_src}' alt='Task ID {task_id} sparkline'>
    <p class='back-to-toc'><a href='#project-toc'>Back to TOC</a></p>
</section>
""".strip().format(task_id=task_id, task_image_src=task_image_src, task_label=task_label)
                )

    display(HTML("\n".join(html_parts)))
```
